request_id.description: Stable dedup key: hash of conversation_id + request_timestamp + destination

conversation_id.description: Outlook conversationId (snake_case in our data; corrected from camelCase 2026-04-29)

etd_requested.description: Lonny's requested ETD (departure-side counterpart to eta_requested).

free_time_requested.description: Free time Lonny ASKED FOR in the RFQ body. Distinct from free_time / origin_free_time / dest_free_time, which are what the carrier OFFERED. Written by ingest at row construction.

demurrage_free.description: Destination-side free time (days, integer). Parsed from booking body via int(...).

detention_free.description: Origin-side free time (days, integer). Parsed from booking body via int(...).

ol_responder_email.description: Email address that sent the rate response (typically the MBD shared mailbox).

ol_responder_signer.description: Human signer extracted from the rate-response body — distinct from the shared mailbox.

ol_rate.description: Per-container rate when quoted; null on non-quoted (NQ) rows. The "Not Quoted" display label is computed at render time, not stored.

rate_expiry.description: Validity-window string parsed from the rate response body.

pol.description: Port of loading as NAMED IN THE EMAIL — the raw parsed value, not the canonical `origin`. Written by ingest at row construction, backfilled by QC's port heal. Placeholder-scrubbed alongside origin/destination.

pod.description: Port of discharge as NAMED IN THE EMAIL — the raw parsed value, not the canonical `destination`. Written by ingest at row construction, backfilled by QC's port heal. Placeholder-scrubbed alongside origin/destination.

manual_locked.description: TRUE when an operator correction set this row's fields. LOAD-BEARING: every re-decide and heal path must skip a locked row, so an automatic rule cannot silently overwrite a human verdict on the next fire. Set by ingest's operator-correction pass; read by drift_check and QC.

mdolx_refs_all.description: All MDOLX refs seen across the conversation; mdolx_ref is the canonical/first.

reason_detail.description: Human-readable reason narrative — e.g. 'Lonny replied Send 2026-04-24 | MBD MDOLX260420 2026-04-25'.

etd_fit_days.description: Days between Lonny's requested date and OL offered ETD/ETA. Negative = earlier than asked.

booking_events.description: Audit trail of MDOLX booking confirmations matched to this row. Null when no booking has matched yet.

send_signal_events.description: Audit trail of Lonny send-signal detections in this conversation.

source_ids.description: Outlook message IDs of source emails for this row.

source_imids.description: Internet Message-IDs of source emails (cross-account stable handle).

equipment_size.description: Canonical equipment slug derived from containers (e.g. '40HC', '20+40RF'). Computed in qc.phase_4_5_derived_fields.

rate_per_feu.description: ol_rate normalized to per-FEU (40' equivalent) for cross-lane comparison. Computed via core.parse_rate_per_feu.

trade_region.description: Trade-region bucket derived from destination (China / Japan / Mediterranean / etc.). 'Other' when no keyword matches. Computed via core.trade_region.

awarded_carrier.description: Carrier that received the booking. Alias of carrier_won — exposed under both names so analytics can read either.

validity_window.description: Quoted rate's validity window (e.g. '5/15-5/31'). Sourced from ingest's rate_expiry, or extracted from body via core.parse_validity_window.

win_rate.description: Percent. wins / (wins + quoted_lost + not_quoted). Pending excluded.

quote_rate.description: Percent. (wins + quoted_lost + pending) / total. Pending counts as quoted.

loss_reasons.description: Per-reason loss count for this carrier. Map of loss_reason -> count. Computed in core.aggregate_carriers.

loss_reason_summary.description: Human-readable rollup of loss_reasons sorted by frequency (e.g. '4 PRICE, 2 ETD_MISS').
